snippet.title: The Last Flight - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The Last Flight Demo now available on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3906460/The_Last_Flight/

Jump into the generated island world and take the first steps from small-time mechanic to Fighterjet. Survive and build your junky plane before someone notices your past faults.

Discord ▶   https://discord.gg/ypK6YH4gB2 
TikTok ▶  https://www.tiktok.com/@thelastflightgame

Download the full-quality trailer here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ggcbD0uJWiyxaD7yvCCUoy2YF97gmgDV?usp=sharing

Created by Christor. 
Trailer music composed by @kulpar4m33pilla88 .
